# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# fields: COMMAND_RPC_CREATE_WALLET::response_t, src/wallet/wallet_rpc_server_commands_defs.h:2200-2204
#         -- EMPTY. The served result is {}: this file's only key is _provenance and fmonero-mock
#         strips every top-level key beginning with "_".
# request: { filename string, password string, language string } (:2186-2197). ALL THREE are plain
#         KV_SERIALIZE, none optional.
# NO WALLET FILE IS EVER CREATED by this fixture. §4b is explicit that `wallet create` against the
#         mock "proves the request shape, the double prompt and the empty-password refusal only".
# `language` IS REQUIRED AND AN UNKNOWN VALUE IS REJECTED: is_valid_language(req.language) fails with
#         -1 UNKNOWN_ERROR "Unknown language: <x>" (src/wallet/wallet_rpc_server.cpp:3576-3581), which
#         under §1b.4's error map would fall to exit 5 -- an upstream error for a local mistake. So
#         fmonero validates the name LOCALLY first, against the twelve-row SEED_LANGUAGES table
#         (§1b.4, from src/mnemonics/electrum-words.cpp:437-452), and defaults to "English".
#         is_valid_language accepts EITHER the native OR the English name (the predicate at :494-500
#         is get_english_language_name() == language || get_language_name() == language), so a table
#         of English names only -- or of native names only -- refuses half the values the daemon
#         accepts, with exit 2, locally: the failure mode the pre-check exists to avoid, inverted.
#         EnglishOld is a Language class but is NOT in get_language_list() and is rejected.
# `password` IS TAKEN VERBATIM WITH NO EMPTINESS CHECK (:3583-3595, :3611), so an empty prompt
#         silently creates an UNENCRYPTED wallet. That is why `wallet create` prompts twice on a TTY
#         and compares, and refuses an empty password without --allow-empty-password (§2b.2).
# create_wallet LEAVES THE NEW WALLET OPEN: on_create_wallet ends `m_wallet = wal.release()` (:3639).
#         So `wallet create` must finish the last three steps of wallet_session::open on it --
#         set_daemon, auto_refresh, state::set_last_open -- or the wallet it just made is open with no
#         daemon credential and no recorded name (§4.1).
# THE SEED IS NEVER RETURNED BY THIS CALL AND NEVER PRINTED BY fmonero (§2b.2). §5c's `wallet create`
#         payload carries `seed_backup_hint` -- the monero-wallet-cli command that shows it -- and
#         NEVER `seed`.
